selection_method: 10 current leaf commerce categories with >=10 live PDPs; for each category, the first 10 real product cards in the live Recommended grid order were selected. Editorial/category links were excluded.
notes: Variants with distinct Best&Less PDP URLs are intentionally separate eval products.
Null unasserted fields are not extraction failures; they are omitted from ground truth to avoid model-inferred values.
The dataset is designed first for Commerce Suite category/product discovery and catalog normalization evaluation.
